questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=12D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।
